**Root Cause**: The contradictory reports were caused by a **feature flag creating two different user experiences**. The team had deployed a new ML search algorithm to 30% of users while keeping the old algorithm for 70% of users.

**Key Details**:
- **30% of users** (including Alice) experienced the new, improved ML search algorithm
- **70% of users** (including Charlie) experienced the old search algorithm

- The 30/70 split in engagement metrics eventually revealed the truth - there was no bug, just two parallel systems

The confusion arose because the team was "debugging two different systems without realizing it" - a classic case of feature flags creating "parallel realities" that made collaborative debugging nearly impossible.

**Resolution**: This led to a new policy requiring explicit test group assignments for internal team members during feature rollouts, and the new algorithm was eventually rolled out to 100% of users based on its superior performance.
